_meta.purpose: Product-role fork classification SSOT for canonical skills, commands, provider-only agents, and the separately classified hook surface. Product instructions, provider adapters, launcher inventories, rules, and references have their own registry-declared canonical owners and are not reclassified here.
_meta.source: The legacy all-home gap audit was retired when the provider-neutral product instruction and registry-driven materializers became authoritative. Historical per-home prose is provenance only and is intentionally absent from this executable classification.
_meta.authority: packages/design-system/ds-canonical/** + scripts/fork-role-sources/** + packages/governance/canonical/providers.json；generated .claude/.agents/.codex views are materializer outputs only
_meta.buckets: SHIP_AS_IS / SHIP_REWRITTEN / DROP；hook-specific REPLACE semantics live only in scripts/fork-hook-classification.json

delivery_mechanisms.hook: scripts/fork-hook-classification.json classifies canonical hooks；the immutable npm corpus and committed provider configs execute the resulting subset
delivery_mechanisms.instruction: scripts/fork-role-sources/AGENTS.product.md owns product-role content and receives the exact Decision Authority block from root AGENTS.md；consumer AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/provider instruction files are generated views
delivery_mechanisms.skill: the generator projects one classified canonical skill tree into every enabled registry-declared provider skill view；exact-version upgrade materializes and recursively verifies it
delivery_mechanisms.launcher: packages/design-system/ds-canonical/templates/product-provider-wiring.json plus packages/governance/canonical/providers.json own launcher/config inventory；this file does not duplicate it
delivery_mechanisms.canonical_read: product agents read exact installed public specs/tokens and any skill-declared canonical reference on demand；no generated full-text preamble exists

replacementOwners.productInstruction: scripts/fork-role-sources/AGENTS.product.md + root AGENTS.md canonical Decision Authority projection

hooks.verdict: Every canonical hook is classified exactly once by the dedicated closed hook classification; coverage checks reject missing and ghost entries.

skills.verdict: Product-relevant skills are generated once from canonical skill owners into every enabled provider view; exact upgrades verify recursive path/type/mode/hash parity.
